title: Misty Pine Refuge

[[Image:Misty Pine Refuge.jpg|thumb|300px|Misty Pine Refuge]]
[[Misty Pine Refuge]] is an outpost building of the [[Argent Dawn]]. It is located in central [[Dun Morogh]], and currently houses only one agent of the organization - [[Father Gavin]].
